expectations.text: Flags accounts as the highest-risk prerequisite class because signups, email confirmations and sometimes employer sign-on all land at minute zero, on the room's network, for everyone simultaneously.

expectations.text: Marks each prerequisite as a hard requirement or a comfort.

expectations.text: Adds a pre-travel step asking participants to pull the 2 GB of images on a network they trust, with the reason stated in the participant-facing text.
